generators.carrier: lattice Dirac operator matrices on a finite lattice

relations.hypotheses: lattice Dirac operator with chemical potential entering as e^{+mu} forward and e^{-mu} backward temporal links; staggered eta5 epsilon(x) version for staggered quarks; mass real

relations.statement: det(A^dagger)=conj(det A) and det(gamma5 A gamma5)=det A
relations.hypotheses: finite square complex matrices, gamma5 invertible with gamma5^2=1

lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem det_conj_sym {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (D Dm g5 : Matrix n n ℂ) (h : g5 * D * g5 = Dm.conjTranspose) (hg : g5 * g5 = 1) : star D.det = Dm.det := by sorry

lemmas.statement: For real mu, det D(mu)^* = det D(-mu), so det D(mu) is real iff det D(mu)=det D(-mu); no reality is forced for mu != 0

near_misses.claim: det D(mu) is real for real mu
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The identity relates mu to -mu; the determinant is real only at mu=0 or imaginary mu, so a sign problem arises

near_misses.claim: D(mu) is gamma5-Hermitian for real mu != 0
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: gamma5 D(mu) gamma5 = D(-mu)^dagger, which differs from D(mu)^dagger when mu != 0

open_obligations: No SU(3) staggered operator in checkout; D(mu) is abstract
Staggered version uses epsilon(x) = (-1)^{x1+..+x4} in place of gamma5; must be stated
Imaginary mu case: mu* = -mu gives det real, not proved
